subject: maths
question: A man covered a distance of 280 km in 8 hours on a motorcycle. How much distance will be covered on a bicycle in 2 hours, if he rides the bicycle at (3)/({14)} of the speed of the motorcycle?
solution:
**Given:**

A man covered a distance of 280 km in 8 hours on a motorcycle.

He rides the bicycle at (3)/({14)} of the speed of the motorcycle

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Speed of a motorcycle = (280/8) = 35 km/hr

Now,

He rides the bicycle at (3)/({14)} of the speed of the motorcycle

⇒ (3/14 × 35) km/hr

⇒ 15/2 km/hr

Now,

Distance covered by bicycle = (15/2 × 2) km

⇒ 15 km

**∴ The required distance covered by bicycle is 15 km**
